tickerText: [TENNIS] Andrey Rublev rolls past Timofey Skatov 6-1, 6-1 into Estoril quarterfinals as Portugal's Jaime Faria advances at home • [SQUASH] World Junior Championships semi-finals begin at White Oaks with Assal, Salem and Zakaria in the last four • [BADMINTON] Chen Yufei and Wang Zhiyi headline China Open quarterfinals day in Changzhou after Thursday comeback wins • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open and Italy 125 Portoroz continue with international fields chasing ranking points • [TABLE TENNIS] Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi reach mixed doubles quarterfinals at WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos

newsItems.title: Junior Squash Semi-Finals Set
newsItems.excerpt: Marwan Assal and Ruqayya Salem fight back into the last four at Niagara-on-the-Lake, joining Mohamad Zakaria as semi-finals begin Friday at White Oaks.

newsItems.title: China Open Quarterfinals Day
newsItems.excerpt: Chen Yufei and defending champion Wang Zhiyi lead Friday's field in Changzhou after booking last-eight spots with comeback round-of-16 wins.

newsItems.title: PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open Rolls On
newsItems.excerpt: The inaugural PPA Asia 500 at Sports Arina continues alongside the PPA Italy 125 in Portoroz as pros compete across two international tour stops.

newsItems.title: Calderano and Takahashi Into Mixed QF
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 2 mixed pair Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi sweep into the quarterfinals at WTT Star Contender São José dos Campos with a 3-0 win.
